title: mentha × kerneri f. acutifolia
intro: Mentha × kerneri f. acutifolia, commonly known as Kerner's mint, is a hybrid plant species within the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal and aromatic properties, providing relief from digestive issues, headaches, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Kerner's mint include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which work together to soothe the digestive system, calm muscle spasms, and alleviate congestion. The bioactive constituents of Mentha × kerneri f. acutifolia include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
